translations.web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
translations.bsb: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
translations.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
translations.asv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.
